name: ci-polling
title: CI Polling & Auto-Fix Loop
description: Polls CI status on a branch. On failure: extracts logs, feeds Claude, applies minimal fix, commits and re-pushes. Loops until green or max attempts. Inspired by loops.elorm.xyz 'Ship PR Until Green' pattern.
author: SolSolis-Sys

inputs.name: max_fix_attempts
inputs.description: Max auto-fix attempts before escalating to human

agents.prompt: Check CI status for branch {{branch}} on repo {{repo}}: `gh run list --branch {{branch}} --repo {{repo}} --limit 1 --json status,conclusion,databaseId`. Return: { status: string, conclusion: string|null, run_id: string }
Extract CI failure logs: `gh run view {{watcher.run_id}} --repo {{repo}} --log-failed`. Return: { failing_step: string, error_lines: string (max 60 lines), file_hints: string[] }

Fix CI failure based on logs: {{log_extractor.error_lines}}. Focus on: {{log_extractor.file_hints}}. Apply minimal targeted fix. Then commit: `git commit -am 'fix: auto-fix CI — {{log_extractor.failing_step}}'` and `git push`. Report what changed.
